description: Texts in an accordion beside a card of specs.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The details of a product under its buy box: texts in an accordion (native details) beside a card with the
  specs. Axes: layout (split: the specs beside the texts, stacked: below them), expand (first: the first text
  open, none), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Detail, Spec, ProductInfoLabels } from "./product-info.types";

export type ProductInfoProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  details: Detail[];
  specs: Spec[];
  labels: ProductInfoLabels;
  layout?: "split" | "stacked";
  expand?: "first" | "none";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Disclosure from "../compose/Disclosure.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Summary from "../compose/Summary.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  details,
  specs,
  labels,
  layout = "split",
  expand = "first",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ProductInfoProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <Box
      :class="
        (layout as string) === 'split' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3'
        : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-8'
      "
    >
      <Stack v-if="((details?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
        gap="0"
        align="stretch"
        :class="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? 'lg:col-span-2' : '')"
        data-slot="items"
      >
        <Disclosure
          v-for="(d, i) in details"
          :key="d.id"
          variant="item"
          :open="(((expand as string) === 'first') && (i === 0))"
          data-slot="item"
        >
          <Summary variant="item">
            <Inline class="text-base font-semibold">
              {{ d.title }}
            </Inline>
          </Summary>
          <Text size="sm" class="pb-4 text-muted-foreground">
            {{ d.text }}
          </Text>
        </Disclosure>
      </Stack>
      <Stack
        v-if="((specs?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
        gap="4"
        align="stretch"
        class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6"
        data-slot="specs"
      >
        <Title :as="3" size="lg" weight="bold">
          {{ labels.specs }}
        </Title>
        <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col">
          <ListItem v-for="s in specs" :key="s.id"
            class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border py-2 text-sm last:border-b-0"
            data-slot="spec"
          >
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ s.label }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {{ s.value }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
